{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]  # Remove sentinel values

df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)

df_dedup = df.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Now compute the response fraction only in the treatment arm
treatment_arm = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']
response_fraction = treatment_arm['responded'].mean()

response_fraction"}
